$comment: Every moderate/high advisory reported by `npm audit` must be fixed or listed here. Critical advisories cannot be excepted. Each entry is re-reviewed before `expires`; the gate fails on expiry. Scope meanings: build-tool = runs only on the build/CI machine against repository-controlled inputs and is verified absent from shipped bundles; dev-tool = test/dev tooling only; runtime-unreachable = ships in an artifact but the vulnerable function is not called (evidence required).

exceptions.artifact: none shipped; Metro file crawler on the build machine
exceptions.justification: Stack-exhaustion DoS via deeply nested brace patterns. Patterns come only from Metro/Expo configuration in this repository, never from users or the network.
exceptions.evidence: No patched braces release exists (3.0.3 is the latest). Absent from Android/iOS bundle source maps (checked by scripts/security-gate.mjs --bundle-map in CI).
exceptions.remediation: Expo SDK upgrade once Metro moves to a patched matcher (npm audit fix target: expo@58).

exceptions.artifact: none shipped; Metro reads image dimensions of repository assets at bundle time
exceptions.justification: Infinite-loop DoS on crafted JXL/HEIF/ICNS files. Only repository assets are parsed; the app never parses images with this library at runtime.
exceptions.evidence: Fix exists only in image-size 2.x, whose API (Buffer-only imageSize, separate imageSizeFromFile) is incompatible with metro@0.83 calling imageSize(path); forcing it would break asset bundling. Absent from bundle source maps (gate-checked).

exceptions.artifact: none shipped; Expo CLI manifest code signing
exceptions.justification: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification flaw. Used by Expo CLI only for expo-updates manifest code signing; this app does not install expo-updates and app.json configures no codeSigningCertificate, so no signature is verified with node-forge in any build or at runtime.
exceptions.evidence: No patched node-forge release exists (1.4.0 is the latest). apps/mobile/app.json has no updates/codeSigning config; expo-updates absent from apps/mobile/package.json. Absent from bundle source maps (gate-checked).
exceptions.remediation: Re-evaluate before enabling expo-updates/code signing; Expo SDK upgrade.

exceptions.path: react-native > babel-jest > babel-plugin-istanbul > @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config > js-yaml > argparse > sprintf-js@1.0.3
exceptions.artifact: none shipped; Jest coverage tooling pulled in by react-native
exceptions.justification: DoS through unbounded precision specifiers. Only reachable via argparse CLI formatting inside coverage tooling, which this repository does not run (tests use vitest).
exceptions.evidence: No patched sprintf-js release exists (1.1.3 is the latest). Absent from bundle source maps (gate-checked).

exceptions.artifact: Android and iOS JS bundles (query-string/index.js and decode-uri-component/index.js are bundled)
exceptions.justification: Exponential decoding DoS on malformed percent-encoded input. In query-string 7.1.3 decodeComponent is reached only through parse/parseUrl/extract decoding. expo-router 6.0.24 calls only queryString.stringify (build/fork/getPathFromState.js:276 and getPathFromState-forks.js:71; its parse call in getStateFromPath.js:538 is commented out), and no other bundled module imports query-string.
exceptions.evidence: Upgrading query-string to 9.x is unsafe: 9.x is ESM default-export only, so expo-router's __importStar(require('query-string')).stringify would be undefined at runtime. stringify output parity between 7.1.3 and 9.5.1 was confirmed, but the interop break makes an override incorrect.
